newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Qualcomm cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Qualcomm cut to hold.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist on Monday cut its rating on shares of Qualcomm Inc to hold from buy based on concerns about increasing competition and inventory in the sales channel.
-- said digital telecommunications equipment maker Qualcomm should face increasing competition in the CDMA handset market from industry heavyweights like Motorola, Nokia, Samsung and others.
-- said recent job cuts at a joint venture that makes CDMA handsets indicates excess inventory in the sales channels.
-- Qualcomm stock was off 9/16 at 47-11/16 by mid-morning.
